title: The New conversation card names the sender the email actually goes out as, the Space's brand name

source.ref: Scan nine (2026-10-19 weekly meta scan), docs/META-SCAN-STATUS.md

detail: The Space Conversations page passed senderName={space.name} to the New conversation card, while the send path (gateSpace, resolveSpaceConversationFrom) uses brandName ?? name. A Space with a brand name saw 'From <space name>' on the card while the email went out under its brand. The card now reads the same brandName ?? name.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/crm/conversations/page.tsx','utf8');if(!s.includes('senderName={space.brandName ?? space.name}')){console.error('SCAN-1004: the New conversation card names the Space, not the brand the email is sent as');process.exit(1)}"
